palantir_trajectory.method_scope: Native Palantir diffusion/Markov trajectory; not elapsed time or experimental ancestry

scgen_predict.method_scope: Native scGen log-normalized decoded prediction; not observed counts or a generic linear substitute

multivi_integrate.method_scope: Native RNA+ATAC MuData API, paired measured cells only; unpaired modality branch not implemented by this route

totalvi_integrate.method_scope: Native RNA+ADT MuData API, paired measured cells only; unpaired modality branch not implemented by this route

monocle3_trajectory.method_scope: Monocle3 on actual reviewed stored UMAP. Not Monocle 2014, Monocle2 DDRTree or Slingshot

diablo_fit.method_scope: Native DIABLO with externally prespecified parameters, fit only. No nested-validation performance claim

snf_fusion.method_scope: Native SNFtool affinity/fusion/spectral clustering; measured matched independent units only

msstats_compare.method_scope: Actual MSstats feature-level comparisons; normalization and missingness decisions explicit, no fabricated intensities

mixscape_classify.method_scope: Native pertpy Mixscape; stratum=unit+celltype+replicate; classifications remain evidence, no automatic cell deletion

cellot_predict.method_scope: Native gradient ICNN prediction using exact reviewed CellOT source and existing checkpoint; no new CellOT training

destvi_deconvolution.method_scope: Actual CondSCVI reference plus native DestVI fitting; matched ordered genes, measured spatial coordinates and counts

cell2location_reference.method_scope: Actual native NB RegressionModel reference fit, q05/q50/q95; q50 is posterior median, not mean

cell2location_map.method_scope: Native posterior mapping from real versioned reference signatures and counts; abundance prior not histological observation

muscat_pseudobulk.method_scope: Native muscat aggregation and edgeR pseudobulk DS with reviewed exact per-cell QC; paired design must span donor effects; no automatic sample-outlier deletion

banksy_domains.method_scope: Native BANKSY neighborhoods and graph clustering independently per actual section, lambda=0 expression baseline retained; cluster numbers not aligned across sections

progeny_activity.method_scope: Actual native PROGENy responsive footprints, perm=1 descriptive scores and exact measured-feature coverage, not generic GSVA or protein activity

drug2cell_score.method_scope: Native Drug2cell, explicit offline target set snapshot and coverage; expression score not drug inhibition/clinical response

cellphonedb_per_unit.method_scope: Native human CellPhoneDB permutation method within observed unit/condition; no pooled-cell population inference and no automated database download

paste_pairwise.method_scope: Native full-mass PASTE pairwise transport and optional native rigid stacking; literal spot axes, known masses, explicit cost and marginal QC; not PASTE2 partial alignment

squidpy_section_statistics.method_scope: Native Squidpy >=1.8.4 radius/Moran/neighborhood/cooccurrence within each section; undefined values retained, actual distance units and RNG version explicit

spark_spatial.method_scope: Actual original SPARK count GLMM and spatial kernel tests per section, not SPARK-X. Native feature/spot attrition and missing p-values preserved

vep_offline.method_scope: Actual offline human VEP, fully bound cache and existing uncompressed FASTA, exact source REF/ALT/record identity and ALLELE_NUM linkage; all transcripts retained, no automatic pathogenicity classification

ldsc_h2.method_scope: Actual existing LDSC h2/intercept command on author-munged statistics, matched bound autosomal LD/M_5_50 references and native log estimates; observed-scale only, not genetic correlation

seurat_to_anndata.method_scope: Observed-layer Seurat-to-AnnData exchange with real R extraction, exact literal axes, count/normalized layer checks and full server write/read equality; no statistical fitting or embedding replacement

cinemaot_effects.method_scope: Native maintained pertpy CINEMA-OT unweighted/label-preweighted Sinkhorn per actual unit/contrast; actual OT matrix identity and effect reconstruction, observed missing arms preserved; not experimental pairing

cellcap_programs.method_scope: Actual exact-source CellCap counts/program training; random-cell optimizer split explicitly descriptive, native response relevance and decoder-weight projection, no independent-donor validation claim

systema_evaluate.method_scope: Native exact-source Systema rank centroid accuracy plus explicitly repaired Pearson helper formula. Same full feature axis and actual independent-unit scenarios across methods; training-only custom reference and panel receipt

xcms_preprocess.method_scope: Native centroid MS1 xcms centWave/obiwarp/correspondence and optional measured peak integration; explicit source-to-sample map, blanks excluded from feature definition, missingness preserved. Not metabolite identification, normalization or abundance inference.

baysor_segment.method_scope: Actual Baysor C++ CLI with exact binary/version; canonical actual transcript IDs, native count reconstruction from molecule assignments, preserved noise and polygon identities. Original Julia implementation/compartment segmentation excluded from this route.

smr_heidi.method_scope: Actual native cis-SMR/HEIDI with full selected offline PLINK/BESD references, exact literal intersecting variants, explicit native frequency/LD thresholds and unassessed HEIDI retained. Not multi-SNP SMR, proof of colocalization or causal mediation.

spatialglue_integrate.method_scope: Native exact-source SpatialGlue two measured modalities on identical actual spots/coordinates, one section per fit. Explicit native datatype parameter overrides and source-bound preprocessing, embedding/attention/terminal losses. No batch-generalization or automatic cell-type claims.

nestedcv_glmnet.method_scope: Actual R nestedcv/caret glmnet, one row per real independent unit, exact outer and nested inner fold assignments, fold-local preprocessing, explicit second-level probability event and no full-data final fit or global supervised filter.

diffdock_pose.method_scope: Actual exact-source current DiffDock single-complex native CLI with pre-existing score/confidence/ESM resources, offline child inference, original graph/stereochemistry preserved and all actual native rank/confidence files retained. Not affinity scoring or original historical model.

diffsbdd_generate.method_scope: Actual exact-source native conditional DiffSBDD pocket-residue sampling; all raw fragments/molecules kept with chemistry/coordinate QC, no silent sanitization/resampling. Not inpainting, property optimization or measured activity.

rfdiffusion_backbone.method_scope: Actual exact-source original RFdiffusion unconditional fixed-length backbone sampling; literal native design files/length checked, native TRB retained opaque without unpickling. Not a functional sequence, binder or RFdiffusion2 all-atom method.

mace_singlepoint.method_scope: Actual native MACE ASE molecular single-point energies/forces from exact existing trusted model, declared units/elements and fixed nonperiodic geometries. Not docking affinity, electronic ESP, periodic MD or scientific validation.

biolord_attributes.method_scope: Native exact-source normal-likelihood biolord attribute fitting and counterfactual combinations on actual optimizer-trained controls; explicit source-cell IDs propagated, no suffix parsing. Random-cell monitoring is descriptive and not independent-donor generalization.

scvidr_predict.method_scope: Original legacy scVIDR discrete response prediction and optional native centroid regression; held out is celltype-treated response, controls remain in VAE training. Native balancing attrition/duplicates retained in explicit source mapping; not heldout donors or dose interpolation.

igv_scoped_report.method_scope: Actual exact-source native IGV reports from scoped VCF/BAM/FASTA; literal reference-allele/contig checks, bounded selected views and existing offline template/assets. Privacy CSP blocks remote connections; browser/read-evidence/clinical interpretation remain separate unverified acceptance.

causcell_counterfactual_fit.method_scope: Actual exact-source original CausCell observed-data fit and within-vocabulary assumed-DAG intervention. Stable concept coding, preserved cell/gene axes and nonempty sampler batches repair original serialization defects. Both native Original/Generated halves are model outputs; no independent-unit predictive validation or causal identification.

batchie_posterior.method_scope: Actual native BATCHIE SparseDrugCombo multichain viability posterior, exact experiment/unit/dose/mask identity and missing candidate outcomes preserved. Explicit legacy RNG streams, posterior intervals and rank Rhat/bulk ESS; DBAL batch selection and experimental dispatch remain separate.

prescient_trajectories.method_scope: Actual exact-source PRESCIENT AutoGenerator stepping with selected literal initial cells, safe exact state dictionary, unchanged checkpoint metric representation/dt/noise/time units and bounded stochastic replicas; not thermodynamic free energy or biological lineage.

proteintalks_predict.method_scope: Actual exact-source original ProteinTalks ppODE point prediction, exact protein/molecular-descriptor/case/baseline/checkpoint axes and fixed trained 6/24/48-hour labels on internal ticks 1/2/3. Binary phenotype definition stays explicit; not continuous synergy, SWAG uncertainty or clinical response.

native_unit_profile_handoff.method_scope: Actual receipt/request/source-bound expression handoff into independent-unit mean profiles, unchanged feature axes, exact cell memberships, explicit source selection/low-support HOLD and observed-vs-decoded distinction. Preserves producer validation scope and every actual target/celltype stratum. Not a new scientific analysis method.
